answer: Coordination Breath Windows. Each agent identity must emit a periodic proof-of-liveness tied to a distinct network path; identical paths collapse into one credit. Identities earn a small umber credit only after surviving several windows, and coordination rights scale with path diversity rather than count. To flood the system, an attacker must rent genuinely separate routes and sustain them across windows, paying recurring bandwidth and hosting costs per viable path. Like a garden walled by upkeep, cheap duplication yields no haven here.
